about_the_game:
11 STRANGERS. OVER 6 KILLING GAMES. KILL, TRUST, OR FALL IN LOVE.

_____________________________________________________________________________

TFTK is Inspired by popular titles - Danganronpa, Your Turn to Die and Saya No Uta. 

_____________________________________________________________________________

You wake up in a locked building with no memory of how you got there. A masked figure forces you and eleven others into a twisted survival game. The rules? Simple. Kill or be killed. 

But beneath the bloodshed lies something deeper - fragile bonds, buried secrets and the terrifying possibility of love in a place built to destroy you.

What will you do when survival means betrayal?

  • Psychological horror meets emotional storytelling

  • Form relationships - or fracture them

  • Choices that shape who lives, who dies and who you become

  • Hand drawn art, deep lore and crazy twists

  • Achievements, branching paths and replayable outcomes

This is a Visual Novel for fans of tension, tragedy and twisted romance. The demo is just the beginning.

Think you're ready to face the horrors waiting inside?

Play the updated demo now — I promise you won't regret it.

Wishlist now to support development and be the first to know when the full game drops <3
